annotations.title: Guild ladder for one raid or dungeon

description: Ranks every guild with an agreed kill in one instance: by bosses killed, then by who reached its latest kill first, then by name; equal rows share a rank. A kill is a guild's once 2 of its members' installs report the same boss there, timed at the earliest report, or once its officers published it on the guild board, which carries no time. The boss list is the encounters 3 installs reported in that instance, in that order; a boss not on it counts for nothing. There is no score, no rating and no total across instances. Use it to compare guilds' progress in one raid or dungeon; use guild_board for one guild's own board, and guild_search to find a guild. Reads Everloot's public player data when connected. Missing or unavailable data is reported explicitly.

faction.description: Only alliance or horde guilds. Without it, both.

instanceMapId.description: The instance's map id: the extId of a search_knowledge hit of kind instance. Omit for the newest raid with a kill.

realm.description: Only guilds on this realm. Without it, every realm.

name: guild_rankings

connected.description: False when no corpus was read; the page is then absent, which is not a measured zero.

dataAsOf.description: The corpus snapshot time, or null when unrecorded.

instance.description: The instance ranked; null when no instance has an agreed kill.

latestKillAt.description: When the guild's latest kill in this instance was first reported, ISO; null when only the officers published it.

rank.description: Equal kills and latest-kill time share a rank.

reason.description: Why nothing was read, when connected is false.

url.description: The everloot.app page that shows this answer, absolute. Absent when there is no such page or it would be empty.
